revisionHistory.change: Theme driven through next-themes; each state given its own URL
revisionHistory.reason: A hand-toggled wrapper class fought the provider's own class on <html>, so light mode rendered white cards on a dark page with unreadable section headings

revisionHistory.change: catalog-search-count-view-row gained flex-wrap; catalog-card-heading-row lets the course name shrink
revisionHistory.reason: At 390px the toolbar pushed the page wider than the viewport and the enrolment count was clipped by the card's rounded overflow
User review: it drew a filter underline. ChoiceTabs defaults to secondary and revision 1.3 took that default by omission; legacy passes primary because these tabs switch the whole panel

revisionHistory.change: Leading glyphs on the view toggle and one-line tab labels
revisionHistory.reason: User feedback that these controls should carry a leading icon. Two new icon meanings and one optional ChoiceTabs slot are proposed rather than applied

revisionHistory.change: ProposedTree replaced by a candidate-local Tree over a candidate-local contract registry; every card and page node became a registry key; comments rewritten to ASCII
revisionHistory.reason: ProposedTree took children, which is a hole belonging only to shells. The refactor was incomplete: CourseCatalogCard still imported the deleted branch and the registry declared neither catalog-card nor enrolled-course-card, so the build failed

revisionHistory.change: LayoutClassName imported from the locked registry instead of aliased to string; collision guard restored; dead contracts/proposed.ts deleted
revisionHistory.reason: The registry header claimed every class was a member of the locked union while the type allowed any string, and the guard that catches a proposed key landing upstream had been dropped. Both are now enforced by the build rather than by a comment

revisionHistory.change: Reworded one comment in CoverImage so it no longer contains the literal suppression token
revisionHistory.reason: The verifier now requires the candidate to pass the target canon lint. The only error was a comment EXPLAINING that the line carries no suppression: no-inline-lint-config matches the token in source text, so prose about a directive reads to it as a directive. Nothing rendered changed.

revisionHistory.change: Declared integrationEdits for the six targets that cannot be byte copies
revisionHistory.reason: Apply detection proved the record treated every target as a byte copy while three are merges into shipped files and three need ~candidate specifiers rewritten to @/ on landing. Without the declaration the handoff gate reports six substituted and blocks. The candidate source is unchanged; only the record contract is.

revisionHistory.change: The three components rewritten in the shipped idiom; the candidate scaffolding reduced to verbatim mirrors of three locked files; catalog-card-grid now names the two card kinds it accepts
revisionHistory.reason: Apply proved the record wrong twice. The candidate had invented a second tree builder taking an ORDERED ARRAY of nodes, which compiled and checked nothing - a wrong slot order, a missing slot or a leaf of the wrong kind all passed. LeagueCard and TopLearners already showed the answer. The scaffolding now only widens ContractKey; every signature is the locked one.

candidate.framework: next 16.1.6, react 19.2.3, tailwind v4, heroui 3.2.4, statically exported
runtimeDifferences: Production resolves the locale per request through the next-intl plugin; the candidate pins the fixture locale vi and imports the target's real src/messages/vi.json.
output: export with basePath /candidate/out, because the review lab is a static server.

files.note: Merge the eleven PROPOSED entries. price-discount-line is restated from the locked table and must not be written back. The collision guard and the restated-key assertion are candidate scaffolding and are not ported.
API extension: one optional per-tab icon slot plus whitespace-nowrap. Existing callers omit icon and are unaffected.
Merge two IconName members and two GLYPHS rows. The feature table in Icon/icon.md and its canon mirror change in the same edit.

candidate/app/** - the state matrix and its providers.

contracts.why: The payable price leads while original price and discount qualify that same commerce fact on one wrapping line.
Query, result count and layout choice all narrow the same list, so they stay on one control row above it, wrapping rather than pushing the page wider than its viewport.
Owned and purchasable courses answer different questions, so each keeps its own titled group and one action meaning.
Catalog courses are interchangeable peers compared side by side, so they share one responsive measure.
A purchasable course reads top to bottom as one decision at one rhythm.
The course name leads while the enrolment count qualifies it from the end of the same line; the name yields width back as the card narrows so the count is never clipped.
Artwork identifies the course while title and progress take the remaining width on one baseline.
Title over progress in one flexible column beside the artwork.
